mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (account, name, password, permissionLevel, accountStatus, createTime, updateTime, isDeleted) VALUES (#{account}, #{name}, #{password}, #{permissionLevel}, #{accountStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user WHERE (accountStatus = #{accountStatus} OR (isDeleted = 1 AND #{accountStatus} = '封禁') OR (isDeleted = 0 AND #{accountStatus} = '启用'))
SELECT permissionLevel FROM user WHERE account = #{account}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET isDeleted = CASE WHEN isDeleted = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, accountStatus = CASE WHEN isDeleted = 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '封禁' END, updateTime = NOW() WHERE account = #{account}

UPDATE user SET name = #{name}, password = #{password}, permissionLevel = #{permissionLevel}, accountStatus = #{accountStatus}, updateTime = #{updateTime}, isDeleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE account = #{account}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
